scope: Composition only: family table, slot capacity, weights, family definitions and the language view (PLAN.md section 2, plan.json). Prospective blueprint, not a runnable suite manifest; no task code, images or checklists exist yet and are frozen individually when they do.

confirmed_decisions.a: Composition as proposed: 20 tasks at 5% each, families F1/F2/F3 at 30% with six slots, F4 at 10% with two slots in Python and Java, per-language subscore over F1 to F3 only. Confirmed by the owner 2026-10-06.

open_decisions_policy: Resolved through dated docs/DECISIONS.md entries citing this freeze; never by editing the frozen files. Capacity, weights or slot changes require a v2 plan with its own freeze.
known_outcomes_available: All Frontier v4 results through the GPT-6 Sol v3.17 run and the frontier quartet sweeps of 2026-09; the v4 candidate log (37 gated candidates, 23 admits); no v5 candidate has been authored or run.
